name: AI Rules in Plain English: What Everyone Should Know
description: Start with existing US law, learn when state and sector requirements need review, and distinguish voluntary frameworks from binding obligations. Practice checking an AI-assisted task and raising a useful concern.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI Rules in Plain English: What Everyone Should Know

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 7 lessons in 3 modules, play the course's Decision Lab to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 20 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
